name: 03222 · Bristol, NH
findings: ZIP 03222 (Bristol) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (15%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03222 (Bristol) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 03222 (Bristol) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
